evidence.observation: Growth-stage verification is explicitly false because the required exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed.
Temperature 750.4 °C and argon flow 100.6 sccm closely match setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; heater power is 44.7%.
Pressure was 2.983 Torr at the same growth setpoints.

Pressure has increased through 3.025 and 3.046 to 3.131 Torr despite approximately constant temperature and argon flow; no pressure acceptance limits or normal-run reference establish whether this is abnormal.

args.missing_evidence: An independent exhaust oxygen measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; pressure reference limits and further pressure readings would resolve the significance of the upward trend. Sample characterization is not yet available.
